combined: Owner note 'B + C'. C already contains B, so the combined design is: B's three clocks as the base (source_at nullable, recorded_at, effective event interval with precision on derived items; no fallback to now) plus C's declared source time zone (caller-declared zone or the literal 'unknown'). Order at intake: (1) take source_at from the segment, else leave null; (2) take the zone from the segment, else the source envelope, else 'unknown'; (3) a naive datetime with zone 'unknown' is stored as wall-clock time flagged tz_unknown, never shifted by read.naive_timezone; (4) recorded_at is always the engine clock. Compatible with M-10 'B + C' (tri-temporal on every record, plus the four bi-temporal stamps on graph edges).
